suggestedProducts.description:
Make a bold statement with purpose. Created in partnership with the Keep-A-Breast Foundation, these limited edition sunglasses pair meaningful impact with stand-out style. The design features a vibrant gloss transparent pink frame enhanced by dynamic color-blocking, paired seamlessly with deep navy non-polarized PureBlend™ lenses that offer crisp visual clarity and full UV protection. Look closely at the temples to reveal a custom-designed Keep-A-Breast wire core running through the transparent arms, perfectly complemented by metallic blue logo hits for a polished, high-contrast finish.

Details:

  • Gender: Women's
  • Frame: Gloss Pink Color-Blocked
  • Lens: PureBlend™ Navy (Non-Polarized)
  • UV Rating: 100% UV Protection
  • Fit / Size: Medium - Large
  • Vibe: Lifestyle
  • In the Box: EVA Case & Microfiber Pouch
suggestedProducts.name: Keep A Breast
